block.l: // https://cydf8.dynamic.land/resources/Realtalk.js class Evaluation { constructor(id) { this.id = id; this.finalizers = []; this.rules = []; this.statements = []; } } class Rule { constructor(id, body) { this.id = id; this.evaluations = {}; this.body = body; } } class Realtalk { constructor(you, your_area) { this.socket = null; this.rules = []; this.send_queue = []; this.receive_buffer = ""; this.next_id = 1; this.active_evaluation = new Evaluation("top"); this.go_to_area(you, your_area); this.say('Claim (you) is a "web agent".', []); // this.say('Claim (you) is at URL (_rt_expr[1]).', [ window.location.href ]); } connect(url) { // const protocol = (window.location.protocol == "https:") ? "wss:" : "ws:"; // this.socket = new WebSocket(protocol + "//" + window.location.hostname + "/ws"); // this.socket = new WebSocket(protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/ws"); this.socket = new WebSocket(url); this.socket.onopen = () => {this.send_messages(); console.log("WebSocket connected");} this.socket.onmessage = (event) => { this.receive_buffer += event.data; while (true) { let i = this.receive_buffer.indexOf("\n"); if (i < 0) { break; } const line = this.receive_buffer.substring(0,i); this.receive_buffer = this.receive_buffer.substring(i+1); const msgs = JSON.parse(line); for (const msg of msgs) { const what = msg.what; if (what == "match") { this.match(msg); } else if (what == "unmatch") { this.unmatch(msg); } } } } this.socket.onclose = (event) => { console.log("websocket closed " + event.code + " " + event.reason + " " + event.wasClean); // setTimeout(() => { window.location.reload(); }, 2000); // refresh in a couple seconds to try reconnecting } // if navigating through the back-forward cache, the websocket will be closed, so we have to refresh window.addEventListener("pageshow", (event) => { if (event.persisted) { window.location.reload(); }}); setTimeout(() => { // hide top-level evaluation at first timeout if (this.active_evaluation && this.active_evaluation.id == "top") { this.active_evaluation = null; } }, 0); }; send_message(msg) { this.send_queue.push(msg); if (!this.send_scheduled) { this.send_scheduled = setTimeout(() => this.send_messages(), 0); } } send_messages() { this.send_scheduled = false; if (this.send_queue.length > 0) { if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== this.socket.OPEN) { this.send_scheduled = setTimeout(() => this.send_messages(), 500); return; } this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(this.send_queue) + "\n"); this.send_queue = []; } } create_id(prefix) { const id = prefix + "_" + this.next_id; this.next_id += 1; return id; } go_to_area(you, area) { this.send_message({ what:"go to area", guest:you, area:area }); } remember(text, expressions) { this.send_message({ what:"remember", text:text, expressions:expressions }); } say(text, expressions) { if (!this.active_evaluation) { throw new Error("Claim and Wish are only allowed at top level or within a When"); } const statement_id = this.create_id("statement"); this.active_evaluation.statements.push(statement_id); this.send_message({ what:"add statement", statement_id:statement_id, text:text, expressions:expressions }); } when(text, expressions, vars, body) { if (!this.active_evaluation) { throw new Error("When is only allowed at top level or within a When"); } const rule = new Rule(this.create_id("rule"), body); this.rules[rule.id] = rule; this.active_evaluation.rules.push(rule.id); this.send_message({ what:"add rule", rule_id:rule.id, text:text, expressions:expressions, vars:vars }); } when_unmatched(body) { if (!this.active_evaluation || this.active_evaluation.id == "top") { throw new Error("'When unmatched' is only allowed within a When"); } this.active_evaluation.finalizers.push(body); } match(msg) { const rule = this.rules[msg.rule_id]; if (!rule) { return; } const old_evaluation = this.active_evaluation; this.active_evaluation = new Evaluation(msg.evaluation_id); rule.evaluations[msg.evaluation_id] = this.active_evaluation; rule.body.apply(null, msg.values); this.active_evaluation = old_evaluation; } unmatch(msg) { const rule = this.rules[msg.rule_id]; if (!rule) { return; } const old_evaluation = this.active_evaluation; this.active_evaluation = null; this.remove_evaluation(msg.evaluation_id, rule); this.active_evaluation = old_evaluation; } remove_evaluation(evaluation_id, rule) { const evaluation = rule.evaluations[evaluation_id]; if (!evaluation) { return; } for (const finalizer of evaluation.finalizers) { finalizer(); } for (const statement_id of evaluation.statements) { this.remove_statement(statement_id); } for (const rule_id of evaluation.rules) { this.remove_rule(rule_id); } delete rule.evaluations[evaluation_id]; } remove_rule(rule_id) { const rule = this.rules[rule_id]; if (!rule) { return; } this.send_message({ what:"remove rule", rule_id:rule_id }); for (const evaluation_id in rule.evaluations) { this.remove_evaluation(evaluation_id, rule); } delete this.rules[rule_id]; } remove_statement(statement_id) { this.send_message({ what:"remove statement", statement_id:statement_id }); } } if (!window._rt || window._rt.socket.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) { const you = "*Web agent " + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000) + "*"; const your_area = "<Area main@cydf8.dynamic.land>"; _rt = new Realtalk(you, your_area); _rt.connect("wss://cydf8.dynamic.land/ws"); window._rt = _rt; } // _rt.remember("Remember [transiently] (key _rt_expr[1]) has value (_rt_expr[2]).", ["sprite1", (100)])
if (_rt) { return window._rt.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN } else {return false}
